item.title: IPv6 just turned 30 and still hasn't taken over the world
item.description:
📝 For many, the decision of which protocol to use was easy because IPv6 didn't add features that represented major improvements. Another innovation that meant IPv6 made less sense was network address translation (NAT), which allows many devices to share a single public IPv4 address. Because NAT stalled IPv6 adoption, vendors didn't rally behind the new protocol.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theregister.com/2025/12/31/ipv6_at_30/
